chunks: And from his sermons (peace be upon him) regarding the characteristics of the misguided and the negligent, and in it he exhorts the people.

key_terms.الضَّالِّينَ: The misguided; those who have gone astray from the truth.
key_terms.الْغَافِلِينَ: The negligent; those who are heedless or unaware of spiritual matters.
key_terms.يَعِظُ: He exhorts; he gives moral advice or warning.

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of the misguided and negligent according to Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delineates the spiritual pathologies of the astray and the heedless, categorizing them alongside beasts and carnivores to illustrate varying degrees of cognitive and moral deficiency. This exhortation serves as a diagnostic tool for the community, urging believers to cultivate *ghaflah* (heedlessness) awareness to avoid the stagnation of the soul. The classification reflects the Shia emphasis on *taqwa* as an active state of vigilance against both external misguidance and internal negligence.
